login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your merchant account phone number.

completion.completeDescription: You have signed in to your merchant account.

feedback.invalidPhone: The phone number must contain 9 digits.
feedback.invalidOtp: The verification code must contain 6 digits.
feedback.otpNotExpired: You can request a new code after the current one expires.
feedback.otpExpired: The verification code has expired. Request a new code.
feedback.sessionExpired: The sign-in session has expired. Start again.
feedback.blocked: Sign-in from this device is temporarily blocked.
feedback.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
feedback.unavailable: The sign-in service is currently unavailable.
feedback.contract: An unexpected response was received. Start signing in again.
feedback.request: Unable to complete the request. Start signing in again.
feedback.ownerBusy: The account is open in another window. Close that window or sign out there, then try again.
feedback.browserUnsupported: This browser does not support secure sign-in.
feedback.deviceStorageUnavailable: Unable to securely store the device identifier.

logout.remoteUnconfirmed: You have signed out in this window. Server session termination could not be confirmed.
